name: Tempo Bench Press
instructions: Unrack a barbell for a standard bench press.
Lower over a slow 3-4 count, keeping the bar path consistent.
Touch the chest lightly, then press up at normal speed.
The slow eccentric increases time under tension and control.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: An intermediate barbell press-pattern exercise targeting the chest. Tempo Bench Press builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
